articles.titleZh: 我们对胡塞武装袭击沙特阿拉伯机场的了解| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Saudi Arabia’s energy minister has threatened a 'serious' response to the deadly Houthi attacks on Riyadh's international airport. Flights remain suspended and are expected to remain so for days. 
 
The Houthis said they launched the attacks in retaliation for "brutal Saudi aggression" against areas they control in western Yemen.
 
The BBC’s security correspondent Frank Gardner examines how it is that Saudia Arabia - which spends billions on its defence - can not stop the Houthis from attacking its people.  
 
Subscribe here: http://bit.ly/1rbfUog 
 
For more news, analysis and features, visit: www.bbc.com/news
 
#SaudiArabia #Houthis #BBCNews

articles.title: John Simpson on the pivotal moments that shaped the world as we know it | The Global Story
articles.titleZh: 约翰·辛普森谈塑造我们所知世界的关键时刻|全球故事
articles.summary:
Politicians and commentators keep telling us we’re living through unprecedented times. But how unusual is the world we’re living in, really? 

John Simpson has spent 60 years reporting for the BBC, witnessing some of the most consequential moments in modern history. He was on the plane that brought Ayatollah Khomeini back to Iran during the 1979 revolution. He watched the Berlin Wall come down. And he reported from Beijing during the protests in Tiananmen Square. 

Those experiences have left Simpson with a perspective that’s not entirely pessimistic. Having lived through the Cold War, the collapse of the Soviet Union and the end of apartheid, Simpson has seen seemingly entrenched systems change in ways few thought possible. 

Now, as wars rage and the global order shifts again, he joins The Global Story’s Asma Khalid to reflect on what those moments can tell us about the present — and whether today’s conflicts are repeating familiar patterns.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingTextZh:
政客和评论家不断告诉我们，我们正在经历前所未有的时代。

但是，我们生活的这个世界到底有多不寻常呢？

约翰·辛普森（ John Simpson ）在英国广播公司（ BBC ）工作了60年，见证了现代历史上一些最重要的时刻。

他在1979年革命期间乘坐飞机将阿亚图拉·霍梅尼带回伊朗。

他看着柏林墙倒塌。

他在天安门广场的抗议活动中从北京报道。

这些经历给辛普森留下了一个并不完全悲观的视角。

辛普森经历了冷战、苏联解体和种族隔离的结束，看到了看似根深蒂固的系统以几乎不可能的方式发生变化。

现在，随着战争的肆虐和全球秩序的再次转变，他加入了《全球故事》的阿斯玛·哈立德（ Asma Khalid ） ，反思这些时刻可以告诉我们当下的情况，以及当今的冲突是否正在重复熟悉的模式。
